about: [C7] proof 3 of WAVE_C §7 for VII's fist fight (?start=warehouse.fight): a player who uses what II taught (reads the dodge cue on his hook and what he throws, slips toward the light, punishes the opening with a loaded punch, jabs the side he drops: tools/lib/fight_bot.mjs 'good') wins twice in a row (the second from the fight's beat again, as a retry), each in the length of a second fight. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/pier_fight_good.json

steps.check: D.fights.length === 2 && D.fights.every((f) => f.won && f.downs <= 1 && f.time >= 30 && f.time <= 200)
steps.label: the taught player wins twice in a row

steps.eval: G.brawl.stats.cues && { shown: G.brawl.stats.cues.shown, right: G.brawl.stats.cues.right, wrong: G.brawl.stats.cues.wrong }
